title: NEXARA Reasoning Kernel Architecture Design Contract V1
description: Architecture freeze for the Reasoning Kernel — cognitive inference layer. ZERO runtime modification.

design_principles.p1: Reasoning ABOVE Runtime — enriches context, advises decisions, NEVER executes tools
design_principles.p2: Every Step Has Evidence — every reasoning step traceable to source evidence
design_principles.p3: Uncertainty Is Quantified — every conclusion carries explicit confidence score
design_principles.p4: Self-Check Is Mandatory — every chain verified before presentation
design_principles.p5: Memory Is the Fuel — reasoning draws exclusively from Memory Brain

existing_foundation.chief_brain_kernel: brain/kernel.py — orchestrates intent analysis, decision gates
existing_foundation.memory_brain: brain/memory_controller.py — ranked retrieval available via rank_retrieve()

1_reasoning_kernel_contract.name: Reasoning Kernel Contract
1_reasoning_kernel_contract.description: Formal interface: inputs = MissionContext + AssembledKnowledge + ReasoningQuery. outputs = ReasoningResult + ReasoningTrace.
guarantees: Every output has explicit confidence score 0.0-1.0
Every step cites source evidence or memory record
Self-check runs before returning final result
Deterministic given same inputs (no model calls)

3_context_assembly.name: Context Assembly
3_context_assembly.description: Gathers relevant knowledge from Memory Brain for reasoning. 6-step pipeline.
pipeline: 2. Memory Retrieval — rank_retrieve() across 4 layers, min_confidence=0.3
3. Past Decision Retrieval — DECISION kind memories for similar missions
5. Context Deduplication — remove redundant, keep highest-confidence
6. Context Bounding — trim to 50 items / 5000 tokens max

4_memory_retrieval_strategy.name: Memory Retrieval Strategy
4_memory_retrieval_strategy.description: 5 strategies for layered retrieval with progressive specificity.
4_memory_retrieval_strategy.progressive_retrieval: If confidence < 0.7, re-query with +50% top_k, min_conf -0.1

5_decision_framework.name: Decision Framework
5_decision_framework.description: 6-step structured decision process with alternatives, evidence weighting, and outcome prediction.
steps: 3. Evidence Weighting — score by evidence_strength, past_similarity, preference_alignment, risk_tolerance
5. Outcome Prediction — expected result with similar_case_references
6. Decision Recording — write to DecisionMemory via MemoryBrain

6_confidence_evaluation.name: Confidence Evaluation
6_confidence_evaluation.description: 5-factor weighted confidence scoring per reasoning step.

7_self_check_mechanism.name: Self-check Mechanism
7_self_check_mechanism.description: 5 automated verification checks on reasoning chain before presentation.

result.overall_pass: TRUE only if ALL checks pass
result.failures: List of failed checks with specific step references

integration_architecture.description: Integrates at ChiefBrainKernel.decide() — pre-processing enrichment. ZERO runtime modification.
flow: ReasoningResult returned to ChiefBrainKernel for policy + budget checks

new_tables_in_brain_state_db: reasoning_traces (trace_id, reasoning_id, step_id, step_type, conclusion, confidence, evidence_refs)

absolute_prohibition: Call external models for reasoning (reasoning is deterministic inference)
allowed_actions: Create brain/reasoning/kernel.py, context_assembler.py, thought_process.py, confidence.py, self_check.py, decision_framework.py
